title: Six pedal inputs in under seven seconds
note: PEDAL TRAVEL IN INCHES FROM NTSB AAR-04/04 · R = RIGHT, L = LEFT · FULL PEDAL TRAVEL IS FOUR INCHES · THE RECORDER SAMPLED THE PEDALS TWICE A SECOND, SO PEAKS MAY HAVE BEEN HIGHER · THE NTSB FOUND THESE WERE THE FIRST OFFICER'S INPUTS (FINDING 5); THE PILOTS' UNION CONTESTED THE CAUSE

pedal travel to full rudder at 250 kt

_facts: CLAIMS-american587.md ANCHORS: c34 first pedal input 1.7 in right at 0915:51.9; c35 pedal sequence 1.7R → 1.7L → 1.7R → 2.0R → 2.4L → 1.3R between 0915:52 and 0915:58.5 (AAR p.5); c42 0915:58.5 bang; c81 max pedal travel 4 in; c82 rudder limit 9.3° at 250 kt (Table 2); c83 32 lb / 1.2 in for full rudder at 250 KCAS (Table 3). Bars are magnitudes with direction in the label; the window is given as first input (c34) to the bang (c42) because 0915:52 is not itself an ANCHORS value. The FDR 2/s sampling caveat is from item 164 (CLAIMS §B.4). Attribution to the first officer is Finding 5 and is stated as the NTSB's finding on the note line.
